slipway.description: Primary orchestrator — routes the PRD pipeline, never generates content directly

inspector.description: Cross-doc validation + severity-ranked findings + plain-language summary

groomer.description: Multi-role sprint grooming — Lead Dev, QA, and DevOps lenses

shipwright.description: Update existing docs when a new feature is introduced (extend mode)

chronicler.description: Post-implementation doc sync — detect drift, patch docs incrementally
